description: This PHP source file defines the LoginController class within the OrangeHRM authentication plugin. The class manages user login functionalities, including rendering the login interface with branding, error messages, social media providers, and CSRF tokens. It extends a base Vue controller and implements public interface features for the login process, utilizing various traits for authentication, event handling, theme management, CSRF protection, and social media authentication.

classes.name: LoginController
classes.description: A controller class for managing user login processes, rendering login pages, and integrating social media authentication within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getHomePageService
methods.description: Provides an instance of HomePageService for retrieving the application's homepage URL.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares and sets up the login component with branding, error messages, CSRF tokens, and social media providers before rendering.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles login requests, redirecting authenticated users to the homepage or displaying the login page.

methods.name: getProvidersList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of social media login providers for display on the login page.
